title: Step 69-G Excel template dry-run import recovery Catalog and Pricing administration
description: Implement HIGH-risk AD-D-19, AD-D-20 and AD-D-21 Admin Excel administration on canonical Step69-F: template contract read, bounded XLSX upload transport, dry-run, idempotent import create, failed-import recovery with WebAuthn Step-Up, Catalog preview/apply, and Pricing preview/apply with exact preview hashes. Preserve source-proven authority only; uploaded XLSX is untrusted, no import list/status read may be invented, Catalog and Pricing apply remain separate, no new Product creation is claimed, and unknown mutation outcomes fail closed without blind replay. No Backend/OpenAPI/generated-contract/database, Storefront, Current-State, Product-Design, Step70, production FX-provider or Graph mutation.

evidence.transaction_boundary: Catalog apply and Pricing apply are separate transactions; no combined atomic guarantee exists.
evidence.unknown_outcome: No automatic replay. No source-proven import/status collection/read endpoint exists, so uncertain import/apply/recovery outcomes are surfaced for manual reconciliation rather than blind replay.

acceptance_criteria.description: AD-D-19 exposes only template read, dry-run, import create and failed-import recovery authority; no import list/status endpoint is invented.

Uploaded XLSX is handled as untrusted binary input and bounded to the source-proven 10 MiB client/server envelope while Backend remains authority for ZIP, expanded-size, row, column, macro/formula/link and workbook-structure validation.
Import create sends a server-derived Idempotency-Key bound to exact workbook bytes and never exposes browser-supplied key authority.
Recovery requires bounded UUID/note input, WebAuthn Step-Up and a server-derived scoped Idempotency-Key; unknown outcome is not automatically replayed and no fabricated status lookup is offered.
AD-D-20 Catalog preview/apply uses exact workbook + previewHash, Step-Up and idempotency on apply, shows existing Product/Variant operations only and never claims new-product creation.
AD-D-21 Pricing preview/apply uses exact workbook + previewHash, Step-Up and idempotency, displays Toman/current/proposed/guard data and preserves current-price check semantics.
Catalog and Pricing apply remain explicitly separate/non-atomic; unknown outcomes fail closed and no combined apply or blind retry is invented.

Persian RTL Excel workspace is keyboard reachable, prevents double submission, exposes request IDs, preserves reviewed file identity/hash context across Step-Up, and provides responsive review tables.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
